notes.title: Hotfix 8
Celebrate Questlist's one-year anniversary with DLCs + update!
notes.notes:
[i]Questlist[/i] released on Feb. 18 2021, one year and some days ago. 
Time flies, and we at [i]Rascal Devworks[/i] decided to properly celebrate this milestone ːsweetelfː
[h1]New DLCs ▪ artbook and dakimakura files![/h1]
Two new DLCs have been added to the game, and launch with a week-long 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913350/After_I_met_that_catgirl_my_questlist_got_too_long__Artbook
Previously available only to Kickstarter backers, the [b]artbook[/b] includes all the artwork of the [u]base game[/u], plus some bonus guides with tips and tricks! It's chock-full with spoilers, so we recommend completing the game at least once before giving it a look.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913351/After_I_met_that_catgirl_my_questlist_got_too_long__Dakimakura_pack
The [b]dakimakura pack[/b] includes pin-up files of Vera, Téa and Reniel for self-printing! 
They are intended for 150x50cm cases ːcharmwitchː

[h3]Backer DLC pack[/h3]
Kickstarter backers who previously owned the artbook will see it upgraded to the deluxe [b]Backer DLC pack[/b]! The pack includes content of both existing DLC (artbook and dakis), plus exclusive wallpapers and emojis! 

[h1]Anniversary patch[/h1]
Download the latest update to enjoy some bonus content and several fixes!
[h2]New content ▪ meet the Envoy[/h2]
On day 14, after coming back from a chocolate-y mission in Brightway, you'll receive an informal request from Sparkles. Head over to Cyana and you'll be able to meet the Envoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/3c4d3bb4740ee7ec3af58fd1935ef35e7e487687.gif[/img]
Are you past day 14? No problem! You're still able to meet her. 
Here's Sparkles' hint: [spoiler]she's been sighted around one of the watchtowers by the sea.[/spoiler]

Complete the encounter to receive a [b]special jewel[/b]. There are three versions of it, and you can only own one. You also won't be able to meet the Envoy on subsequent playthroughs, so choose carefully!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/172bff2af92765c30585afe62ee0764b518c9642.png[/img]
The more battles you win, the stronger the jewel will become. Its power carries over to subsequent playthroughs as well!

If you already completed the game at least once, your meeting with her will be slightly different.

Wait a minute... the Envoy looks familiar, doesn't she? ːfoxintroubleː
You'll be able to play as her in our upcoming game, [i]Sigh of the Abyss - Shadow Bonds[/i] (the free prologue of [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i])!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829640/Sigh_of_the_Abyss_Shadow_Bonds
[h2]Improvements / bug fixes[/h2]
This update includes the following bug fixes:
▪ The conversation with Mannie on day 14 has been reworded to be clearer;
▪ The trigger condition for small straights in Dice Delight has been adjusted;
▪ Added a new description in the quest journal for coming second place in the Quizmaster's fist quiz;
▪ Two entries of Téa's diary do not display an incorrect speaker name anymore;
▪ Fixed collision issues in the highway between Cyana and the Breeding Grounds, and the highway between the Breeding Grounds and the Royal Mines;
▪ Fixed an incorrect teleport in Celia's main route;
▪ Fixed gab dialogue in the sewers triggering regardless of party composition;
▪ Fixed getting the achievement for a completed gallery with 34 CGs instead of 35;

[h1]Thank you for a great year[/h1]
The game has been resting at [i]Very Positive[/i] for quite some time! The warm reception has made us incredibly proud, and we're happy so many people experienced the adventures of Vera & co.!
ːangryangrylyraː ːsunnythemenaceː ːpoutycatgirlː ːfoxintroubleː ːcharmwitchː ːsweetelfː
We always wanted to make a [i]good[/i] game and a [i]good[/i] RPG, and we get the feeling we succeeded. 

[b]THANK YOU[/b] for lovely first year! We hope you'll enjoy our future games as well!

notes.title: Hotfix 3 is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34914700/961713fe0f1de1cc967dae782c5f21bfbb95bc3c.png[/img]
Greetings! We hope you've been enjoying [i]Questlist[/i].
Here's a list of the changes introduced by today's hotfix:
[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed NG+ inheritance of unique accessories
[/list][i]Developer's comment[/i]: the girls' unique accessories kept duplicating (Vera's [i]Lucky Coin[/i], for example), so we cleaned up inheritance for those and for the Amulets.
[h3]Other fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash in the NG+ questlog caused by [i]Noblesse Oblige[/i]
[*]Fixed a crash in the NG+ questlog caused by [i]Fake it till you make it[/i]
[*]Fixed the rewards and descriptions of some quests auto-completed in NG+
[*]Fixed a bug that would remove an inherited Armlet from NG+
[/list]Unfortunately, most of these fixes are [b]not retroactive[/b]—they will be applied to new savefiles, but not existing ones.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: A new patch is here!
Hotfix 1 is live!
Patch Notes 15/06 + exciting news!
Patch Notes 06/06
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We pushed another patch today that should fix a rare crash and make some gameplay elements clearer. Thank you all for reporting the issues!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34914700/18ed3e6a84e087d048d3a25ba1c4961c26d395c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash caused by Battering Ram, one of Reniel's skills in Bastion stance
[*] Fixed damage numbers not displaying properly when an enemy goes first
[*] Made the Quizmaster minigame more forgiving; the fisherman now gives you 10 seconds per trivia. You can find hints about the capital in the library and on the signs
[*] Changed the titles of the [i]Torn between worlds[/i] and [i]A safe haven[/i] quests to reflect their long term nature. [i]Torn between worlds[/i] displays the actual duration, 2 days, while [i]A safe haven[/i] is marked as long term
[/list]
[h1]Did you know about the Community Goals?[/h1]
You can unlock an additional romance for Vera with the Community Goals! You can contribute to them even without pledging.
Read more about them [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rascaldevworks/after-i-met-that-catgirl-my-questlist-got-too-long/posts/2525723]here![/url]

notes.title: Demo release SOON!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34914700/e6a8fc400a4c3d51f6b4cd2f6bc6762adee3da66.png[/img]
Greetings, adventurers!
Are you ready to get a taste of the tongue-in-cheek world of Morpheya?

You'll have to wait just a bit longer.
[h1]A demo of the game is in the works![/h1]
[list][*] With 4 in-game days of content (and a bit more), it's a solid introduction to Vera's story
[*] Full-fledged RPG with exploration and combat (but no treasure chests, because [i]who[/i] would carry a chest all the way to the forest to just leave it there? Nobody. Nobody sane, that is)
[*] VN-style story progression with auto-saving and skipping functions
[*] More than 15 quests and optional content
[*] The first bonding event for each girl, Lyra included!
[*] A cliffhanger that will keep you on the edge of your seat
[/list]
We hope you're looking forward to the demo!
ETA? May, together with a Kickstarter campaign that will hopefully bring the game to life (do you want to have a say in the rewards we'll offer? We made a [url=https://twitter.com/RDevworks/status/1120365444102275073]poll[/url]!).

Wanna follow the development of [i]Catgirl's Questlist[/i]? We're on [url=https://twitter.com/RDevworks]Twitter[/url]!

Do you have questions about the game? Ask them away, we'll be answering them in the pinned F.A.Q. thread in the Forums.
